text:
Asking rents in Hamm stand at a median of 8.10 €/m² (2026-06), up 1.5% on the year and +23.2% over five years. That ranks Hamm #35 of 37 cities; new lets are priced 41% above the 2022 average contract rent of 5.75 €/m².

A 60 m² flat costs about 486 € a month in cold rent, 12.6% of the disposable income of two residents. Listings stay online for about 32 days and 21% are gone within a week; with 1.8% market-active vacancy and +0.9% population growth over five years, the market looks broadly balanced.

The model estimate for twelve months ahead is 8.53 €/m² (+5.2%), with an 80% range of 8.27 to 8.73 €/m²; housing-loan rates are at 4.01%.
